name: Blade Barrier

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a straight wall up to 100 feet long or a ring up to 60 feet across

summary: A wall of whirling blades: Dex save, 6d10 Force, half on a success.
text: The wall is up to 100 ft long, 20 ft high and 5 ft thick (or a ring up to 60 ft across). It gives Three-Quarters Cover and is Difficult Terrain; creatures save when it appears and when they enter it or end a turn in it, once per turn.
